text: みんなが　あいつを　ポケモン　マニアと　よんでるよ！

structure.jp: あいつを　ポケモン　マニアと　よんでるよ！

patterns.name: 〜と呼ぶ
patterns.span: ポケモン　マニアと　よんでる
patterns.explanation: と before よぶ shows the name that someone is called by. ポケモン　マニアと　よんでる = 'call him a PokéManiac'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows something people keep doing; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual talk. よんでる = 'are calling'.
